meta.title: Evolvea · A digital companion to therapy
meta.description: Evolvea — a digital companion to speech and cognitive therapy. Ten minutes a night to rebuild how your child thinks. A logopedist-guided, parent-led daily exercise. Coming soon.

hero.title: Ten minutes a night to rebuild how your child thinks.
hero.lead: Evolvea is a daily exercise parents and children do together. Each prompt is chosen based on your child's last answer — so reasoning, reflection, and curiosity grow one conversation at a time.
hero.note: Now in pilot — sign in, or ask your speech therapist for an invitation.

demo.lead: A parent-guided routine that turns "I can't" into "I'll try a small step." Walk the same path a parent follows at the table — then send the session to your logopedist for evaluation.
steps: Name the feeling — being stuck is normal, not failure.
Plan and reflect — type the answers as you go.
Let them try; prompt when stuck, never solve.
Anchor a takeaway, then send it to the logopedist.

intro.text: Give Leo a small jigsaw (10–20 pieces) — solvable, but not obvious. He owns the thinking. You're a facilitator, not an instructor: no solving, no correcting.
intro.noteBody: Tolerance for difficulty, adaptive self-talk, and effort-based confidence.

feel.h: "How do you feel looking at this?"
feel.text: Ask, then listen. Tap what Leo names — no judgement.
feel.noteBody: Naming the discomfort lowers the threat. Stuck is allowed here.

fields: What is this task asking you to do?
What do you already know that could help?
What could be a first small step?
plan.noteBody: Give plenty of wait time. Don't offer the answers.

engage.text: Leo works on his own. If frustration rises, prompt — never correct:
jobs: "What's one small thing you could test?"
engage.fieldPlaceholder: A quick note for the logopedist…

fields: What did you do well while working on this?
What was difficult — and how did you handle it?
What would you try differently next time?

anchor.text: Leo picks a statement and says it out loud:
says: "I can take this step by step."
anchor.noteBody: Repeat with a new task. Consistency of the questions matters more than the puzzle.

sent.text: Tonight's session and your notes have been shared with Leo's logopedist for evaluation. They'll review the answers and adapt tomorrow's exercise.

project.title: A companion to therapy, not a replacement.
project.lead1: Evolvea is a B2B2C educational-health platform that supports young children with speech and cognitive development. It bridges the gap between the therapy room and the living room: a logopedist recommends it, a parent runs a short guided exercise each day, and the child's progress flows back to shape the next session.
project.lead2: A logopedist assigns a personalised plan from their dashboard. At home, parents get guided parent-and-child activities — never unsupervised screen time — while the platform quietly tracks progress and engagement.

cards.title: Logopedists
cards.body: Independent logopedists, speech specialists, and small clinics extend their care between appointments — and earn recurring income for every active referral.

cards.title: Parents
cards.body: Families get clear, guided exercises and the confidence that the few minutes they spend each day are spent on the right things.

cards.title: Children
cards.body: Children working on speech, memory, or concentration get steady, low-pressure practice that feels like time with a parent — not homework.

info.title: A small habit with a serious idea behind it.

cards.title: Thinking out loud
cards.body: Children who put their reasoning into words learn to notice it — and to steer it. That awareness is the skill being built.

cards.title: Effort over answers
cards.body: The parent never solves or corrects. They ask, then wait. Being stuck stops feeling like failure and starts feeling like the work.

cards.title: One day at a time
cards.body: Consistency of the questions matters far more than the puzzle in front of them. Research shows that regular parent-led practice at home can be as effective as clinic sessions.

footer.text: A digital companion to speech and cognitive therapy
